mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATTACH_FILE ( REF_TYPE, REF_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE, CONTENT_TYPE, REMARK, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{refType}, #{refId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_ID AS "fileId" , REF_TYPE AS "refType" , REF_ID AS "refId" , ORIGINAL_NAME AS "originalName" , STORED_NAME AS "storedName" , FILE_PATH AS "filePath" , FILE_SIZE AS "fileSize" , CONTENT_TYPE AS "contentType" , REMARK AS "remark" , CREATED_BY AS "createdBy" , CREATED_AT AS "createAt" FROM ATTACH_FILE WHERE 1=1 AND REF_TYPE = #{refType} AND REF_ID = #{refId}
